openapi.description: OpenAPI 3.x / Swagger 2.0 document (JSON or YAML): a path relative to the workspace root or an http(s) URL, e.g. ./swagger.json or http://localhost:3000/docs-json.
openapi.x-prompt: Path or URL of the OpenAPI (Swagger) document?

include.description: Comma-separated resource names to generate (default: every resource found), e.g. "mahsulot,kategoriya".

exclude.description: Comma-separated resource names to leave out.

path.description: Directory the feature folders are created in. Defaults to `<sourceRoot>/app/modules/admin`, or the `fuse-feature.path` value of fuse-schematics.json.

project.description: Project in angular.json to read sourceRoot from. Defaults to the first application project.

prefix.description: Component selector prefix. Defaults to `app`, or the `fuse-feature.prefix` value of fuse-schematics.json.

force.description: Regenerate (overwrite) features whose folder already exists. Without it existing features are skipped.

skipRoute.description: Do not register the lazy routes in <sourceRoot>/app/app.routes.ts

skipNav.description: Do not add menu items to <sourceRoot>/app/core/navigation/navigation.ts

skipI18n.description: Do not add translation keys to <sourceRoot>/assets/i18n/*.json
